description: UPDATES an existing contact in a list — this MODIFIES live data. Send only the fields you want to change (email_address, fields, tags, status). `contact_id` is the MD5 hash of the lowercased email address, or the id from list_contacts. EmailOctopus: PUT /lists/{list_id}/contacts/{contact_id}. Returns the updated contact.

contact_id.description: The contact's id — the MD5 hash of the lowercased email address, or the id from list_contacts.

fields.description: Custom field values, keyed by the list's field tag (e.g. {"FirstName": "Ada"}).

status.description: Subscription status: subscribed, pending, or unsubscribed.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the contact, e.g. ["vip", "beta"].

name: emailoctopus_update_contact
title: Update contact
